title: Chinese translation issue for description of PowerToys Run "Visual Studio Code Workspaces" plugin (`VS Code` -> `VS 代码`, `PATH` -> `路径`)
author: lingbopro

status.label: Owned by localization team
status.detail: The Chinese correction for PowerToys Run VS Code Workspaces is already tracked by the localization team in GSH ADO bug 1412159.

next_action.label: Verify a future localization drop
next_action.reason: Avoid a competing repository-side fix while the localization pipeline owns the correction.

judgment.rationale: A PowerToys maintainer sent this specific Chinese translation defect to the localization team as GSH ADO bug 1412159; that tracked work is the current owner and should be verified in a future localization drop.
evidence: The reporter identifies translations of the product token ‘Code’ and environment-variable token ‘PATH’ and supplies the intended correction, the invariant names ‘VS Code’ and ‘PATH’.
The live issue remains open with Area-Localization, Issue-Translation, and Loc-Sent To Team labels.
Maintainer niels9001 linked GSH ADO bug 1412159 and stated that the correction will be tracked and verified before closure.
The live issue has no linked upstream pull request that warrants a separate competing implementation.
judgment.recommended_action: Track https://dev.azure.com/GlobalCollaborationService/Global%20Collaboration%20Service%20Project/_workitems/edit/1412159 through the localization workflow and verify the invariant names ‘VS Code’ and ‘PATH’ in a future PowerToys localization drop before closing the issue.

fix_assessment.rationale: GSH ADO bug 1412159 is a concrete, maintainer-linked localization correction attempt for this exact string. The translation is owned by the localization pipeline rather than a parallel PowerToys source design.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run VS Code Workspaces shows translations of the product token ‘Code’ and environment-variable token ‘PATH’ in Chinese; the reporter expects the invariant names ‘VS Code’ and ‘PATH’. A maintainer has transferred the correction to the localization team under GSH ADO bug 1412159.
known_information: The report targets PowerToys 0.87.1 and the PowerToys Run VS Code Workspaces surface.
The reported current wording is translations of the product token ‘Code’ and environment-variable token ‘PATH’.
The reporter's requested wording or meaning is the invariant names ‘VS Code’ and ‘PATH’.
The issue is labeled Loc-Sent To Team and the maintainer linked GSH ADO bug 1412159.
inferences: The report is sufficiently specific for localization correction; additional reporter diagnostics would not change ownership or the requested wording.
Because the correction is in the localization team’s tracked workflow, a separate PowerToys code plan would duplicate active work.
The issue should remain open until a shipped localization drop is checked; the ADO link alone does not prove that the corrected string has shipped.
issue_context.analysis: The issue body, screenshots or quoted text, and discussion consistently identify one Chinese wording defect. The Loc-Sent To Team label and maintainer comment provide explicit ownership and a public tracking URL. The uncertainty is delivery timing, not root cause or the requested translation, so the lightweight judgment is handled work with an existing fix attempt and no executable Pulse action.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live issue body and every live comment, including minimized comments where present.
Checked the current labels, assignees, state, and linked pull-request references.
Confirmed the issue-specific maintainer handoff to GSH ADO bug 1412159 at https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/37548#issuecomment-5178926091.
Found no linked upstream PR or newer comment indicating that the localization correction has shipped or that ownership changed.
